motifs.name: masonry
motifs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: registered HD replacement texture for the first level of Super Castlevania IV. Repaint the materials as detailed dark hand-painted gothic game art, fine chipped stone and damp moss, same restrained colours and light direction as original. Genuine fine detail and smooth shading, not pixel art or simple sharpening. Retain transparency, no new objects, no labels, no frame or padding, no extra scenery. Extend all edge-cut objects to the exact image edge. Do NOT draw black outlines around tiles. Motif: mossy ruined green-grey stone walls and rubble. Original crop is96x64pixels; output at least1536x1024pixels. Keep EVERY brick course, crack and gap at its original location: do not replace many tiny stones with fewer large blocks. Do not brighten or add glowing highlights. The stone grey and muted olive moss must remain subdued. Empty sky above irregular ruined wall remains transparent; cut right/left/bottom edges remain cut. No ground outside reference.
